model.goal_semantics: position ball entry, free terminal orientation, no stop or hover
model.initial_state: same fixed yaw toward goal and zero pitch for all methods; generated witness must start at exactly this state

gates_before_any_original_implementation: Researcher and ChatGPT review of Stage6A
Obtain nearest abstract-only method details and resolve novelty overlap
Verify modern DIRT/RDG author implementation and licensing or document unavailability without claiming SOTA
Build mature native SST and control RRT on Windows in an isolated environment
Validate identical ODE, forward-only propagation and continuous swept-body certification; reject approximate solutions as strict successes
Record same-language same-kernel comparison path or cross-language overhead controls
Freeze controller reference adapter and test on supplied-control witnesses
Separate approval for any prototype or expanded experiment

development.maps: All historical H5, E and F maps and results, plus analytic supplied-control cases
development.allowed_use: engineering, difficulty calibration, baseline parameters and prototype tuning only after new approval

independent_design.recipe: New control-integrated feasible tube maps with independent distractor obstacles, alternating banked-free S-turn/depth transitions and off-tube decoys; not re-seeded historical templates

tiers.name: easy
tiers.witness: straight, gentle yaw, gentle rise/dive; wide body-plus-margin tube

tiers.name: medium
tiers.witness: combined heading and depth transitions; positive certified gap and separated alternatives

tiers.name: hard
tiers.witness: alternating bounded-rate turns near pitch limit, small positive certified gap, finite-height passages

independent_design.difficulty_thresholds: Pending development-only calibration and approval; lock before any independent map is generated
independent_design.witness: Continuous supplied control schedule independently designed from the candidate sampler or primitive palette, integrated from common initial state, full swept-body and angle limits certified; hidden from planners
independent_design.construction_rule: Place obstacles outside the certified witness tube without repairing maps after observing any planner result; keep explicit floor and ceiling
independent_design.seeds: All map, control-generation and planner seeds registered in a committed manifest after approval and before generation; no seed screening
independent_design.statistical_unit: map; planner seeds nested within map; no treating processing/controller conditions as independent maps
independent_design.invalid_input_policy: Stop on generator/certificate inconsistency; preserve all records, explain and revise protocol prospectively; never delete a map because planners fail
independent_design.negative_controls: Separate analytic/proven infeasible cases only; search timeout is not an infeasibility proof

methods.role: primary mature matched-model strong baseline; fixed radii not SST*
unimplemented H1; same kernel as SST, duration sampling only

modern_challenger: DIRT or RDG to be added through a reviewed protocol amendment after author code/license/model audit; current six-method matrix is not a SOTA-completeness claim

charged_inside_budget: serialization needed to return a valid incumbent
fairness.return_policy: last fully certified incumbent ready within deadline only; record overshoot, never accept a newly validated late incumbent
fairness.shared_preprocessing: map load/index build and their measured times reported separately, cached identically; method-specific preprocessing charged
fairness.parameter_effort: same development wall-time allowance and documented candidate configurations for all state planners; no holdout tuning
fairness.execution: Every returned reference evaluated through the same frozen los_terminal_v1 and common validated reference adapter; controller cost reported separately for every method
fairness.native_vs_tracking: Native control integration success is a separate metric and cannot replace uniform-controller success
fairness.processing: Within-method raw and shortcut references paired from same solve; shortcut inside the shared 10s budget. If no certified shortcut exists, use registered raw fallback and record it
fairness.validity: same outer sphere plus0.25m, continuous interval enclosure, rate/angle limits, goal and initial pose for all methods; no point-only checker
fairness.language_cost: Report native bridge, integration/certification and Python/C++ overhead; include same-kernel SST vs H1 to isolate mechanism

outcomes.conditional_execution: S/E with E=actually executed eligible references, not all registered conditions
outcomes.complete_task: S/K for each fixed pipeline, no_path and certification rejections retained
outcomes.planned_model_feasible: M/K for trajectories reconstructed from returned controls satisfying ODE, all bounds, swept safety and goal; report separately from tracking
diagnostics: time to first strictly certified solution

statistics.primary: map-mean paired difference of complete-task success under uniform frozen tracking, H1 minus same-kernel SST
statistics.secondary: planned-model-feasible success, conditional tracking, first-valid time with timeouts retained as censored/not-found, and certified length only on common successes
statistics.uncertainty: paired map-cluster bootstrap95% interval, seeds resampled only inside sampled map; three seeds are not three maps
statistics.multiplicity: one primary contrast; others exploratory, all reported; no best-seed or best-map subset
statistics.power_limit: 12 maps is a feasibility screen, not a definitive paper-scale power claim; no expansion without separate review

prospective_decision.proceed: Only after all correctness/native/novelty gates and new approval: paired primary improvement>=0.10 with map-cluster95% lower bound>0, no strict-safety false positives, predicted medium/hard-tier and ablation evidence, no development-only effect
prospective_decision.need_evidence: interval overlaps0 or sample size insufficient, modern challenger unverified, native bridge or model mapping not validated; retain all failures and request scientific review
prospective_decision.pivot: equivalent prior mechanism found, same-kernel mature baseline eliminates gap, or model/geometry assumptions dominate the observed benefit
prospective_decision.threshold_status: prospective research-screen criterion, not a measured Stage6A result

resource_and_storage.execution: serial CPU only; no GPU/large experiments in Stage6A
resource_and_storage.trace_policy: one local numeric trace per actual run, public compact per-job CSV and selected necessary plots; reference shared prefixes instead of duplicate traces
